records.text: An anonymous family friend of Andrew Kolvet alleged that Kolvet had said Charlie Kirk lost out on millions when he declined Benjamin Netanyahu's offer.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #5 (Ep a-e7HC6SeK8)

appearances.snippet: A very close family friend of Andrew Kolvet had messaged me early on. ... But moreover, they had mentioned that specifically ... Andrew (Andrew Kolvet) had told them that when Charlie (Charlie Kirk) said no to Benjamin Netanyahu, he lost out on millions. ... Now, I'm going to say allegedly because this is a tip, but I have that tip in writing.

verification.notes: The claim is a nested private-source allegation: an anonymous family friend attributed a statement to Andrew Kolvet about money Kirk allegedly lost by declining Netanyahu's offer. The written tip was not published and no contract, offer terms, or identified witness independently confirms it.

conveyance.original_source: Message from close family friend of Andrew Kolvet
